About the Fest
Three days. Endless vibes.
One unforgettable celebration.

A three-day celebration of energy, creativity, and talent—bringing together music, culture, and unforgettable experiences. Get ready to connect, compete, and create memories that last long after the fest ends.

With a diverse lineup of events ranging from competitive challenges to captivating performances, the fest offers something for everyone. Whether you're here to showcase your skills or simply soak in the atmosphere, every corner promises excitement and new experiences.

50K+Attendees
200+Events
3Epic Days

The Legacy

Born from the vision of VIT's most passionate students, Eminence has grown into one of India's most celebrated university cultural fests. Spectacular performances, boundary-pushing art, unforgettable nights — each year outshines the last.


This year's theme: Ascend — pushing limits, reaching new heights, embracing the extraordinary.
